targeting_context.jd_text:
Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 OTE | Reports to Partnerships (partner GTM and applied AI context) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s enterprise challenge is not simply proving that Claude can perform valuable work. It is making safe, reliable deployment repeatable through external delivery organizations without allowing implementation quality, security
posture, or customer outcomes to vary by partner.

The operating tension is scale versus control: expand enterprise reach through cloud, technology, and services partners while preserving Anthropic’s safety-led product positioning and a consistent technical standard in the field.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a product- and platform-led AI company with a public-benefit corporate structure. Its commercial identity is built around Claude, while its institutional differentiation rests on reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI
systems.

Its enterprise motion is hybrid: direct product adoption must be supported by partner-enabled implementation, change management, and solution development. This makes the ecosystem an execution layer, not merely a referral channel.

The central operating tension is turning a frontier-AI product into durable enterprise workflows while maintaining confidence in accuracy, security, and responsible use.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Claude is positioned for complex knowledge work, including data analysis, writing, coding, and structured problem solving. Anthropic also offers an enterprise plan framed around security, compliance, and the needs of both business teams and
developers.

Enterprise deployment is presented as a multi-phase process spanning technical setup, launch and change management, adoption, and ongoing optimization. That signals a business model dependent on realized usage and organizational rollout—not
only initial software access.

As enterprise buyers evaluate multiple AI platforms, Anthropic must make its safety and reliability narrative operational: visible in architecture choices, implementation patterns, governance, and measurable deployment outcomes.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Daniela Amodei is a co-founder and president.

The key stakeholder map is likely to span:
- Partnerships and commercial leadership, accountable for ecosystem coverage and joint market motions.
- Product and engineering, accountable for partner-ready capabilities and incorporation of deployment feedback.
- Enterprise sales and customer teams, accountable for account strategy, adoption, and commercial outcomes.
- Safety, security, and policy functions, whose standards shape credible enterprise deployment.
- Cloud, technology, and services partners, which extend delivery capacity and influence platform selection.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude is offered as an AI assistant for both business users and developers, creating a deployment environment that spans end-user productivity, internal workflows, and application development.

Anthropic’s enterprise materials emphasize security and compliance alongside product capability. For technical partners, this makes architecture conversations broader than model selection: identity, data handling, access controls, change
management, adoption design, and governance must be translated into deployable patterns.

The company’s stated focus on reliability, interpretability, and steerability gives technical field teams a differentiated architecture narrative. The test is whether those concepts become practical design guidance that delivery teams can
apply consistently.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic explicitly organizes a partner network across cloud, technology, and services firms to address customer AI challenges. This supports a true ecosystem motion rather than a purely direct-sales model.

Accenture publicly presents an Anthropic partnership focused on enterprise AI deployment, productivity, value creation, and new-product development. That is evidence that systems integrators can be both implementation multipliers and
industry-solution builders.

The partner motion likely requires:
- Co-selling around customer outcomes rather than generic model access.
- Joint solution development that packages reusable industry and workflow patterns.
- Technical enablement that helps partner practitioners implement Claude responsibly.
- A clear technical-close model for strategic partner-led opportunities.
- Product-feedback mechanisms that distinguish isolated requests from repeatable ecosystem needs.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s public enterprise deployment guidance and partner-facing network indicate that adoption is moving beyond experimentation toward repeatable organizational rollout.

The urgency is commercial and operational: partners can expand enterprise reach, but inconsistent deployment practices can weaken customer trust in a company whose positioning is closely tied to reliability and safety.

Cloud providers, systems integrators, and technology partners also shape enterprise buying paths. Anthropic’s ecosystem execution must therefore keep pace with partner influence over architecture decisions, implementation capacity, and time
to value.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Building repeatable partner technical motions rather than handling one-off escalations.
- Translating AI platform capabilities into governed enterprise architecture patterns.
- Enabling services partners to deliver consistent customer outcomes at scale.
- Linking technical pre-sales, adoption design, and product feedback into one operating loop.
- Leading through the scale-versus-control tension inherent in partner-delivered AI.
- Establishing technical standards that preserve trust, security, and implementation quality.
- Creating joint solution frameworks that help partners move from experimentation to production use.
- Communicating credibly across executive buyers, partner leaders, practitioners, product, and engineering.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s partner network makes technical enablement a strategic growth lever, not a support function.
- Claude Enterprise rollout guidance suggests adoption and change management matter alongside technical deployment.
- The opportunity appears centered on making safety-led AI deployment repeatable through partners.
- Accenture’s public Anthropic practice illustrates the importance of partner-delivered enterprise outcomes.
- Claude’s business-user and developer orientation creates a need for architectures that bridge workflow adoption and technical implementation.
- The role sits where ecosystem scale, customer value realization, and Anthropic’s reliability standards meet.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims, outcomes, leadership scope, technical depth, and partnership results must come from the governed resume and proof graph.

You are evaluating exactly 6 employment bullets (bul_unify_001..006).
This is a BULLET-LINE lane — not an executive summary paragraph.
Return JSON only with: score_scale, score, threshold, pass, decisive_failure, findings, cited_sentence_indexes, remediation_suggestions.

Score contract:
- score_scale must be "0_to_1" or "0_to_5" only.
- Keep score and threshold within the declared scale.
- Employment pool lanes: min_selection_score is the pass floor for Claude pool selection.

Rubric dimensions (employment bullets — not executive summary):
1. claim_ledger_grounding: each bullet maps to bul_* source_fact_ids in the claim ledger; metrics match allowed facts verbatim.
2. bullet_line_discipline: one high-impact resume bullet per slot — concise line, no narrative paragraph or multi-sentence block.
3. jd_briefing_targeting_discipline: JD and briefing shape emphasis only — never JD-as-proof, briefing-as-proof, or target company as experience.
4. keyword_discipline_without_stuffing: role-relevant phrasing without ATS keyword bags or copied JD phrases as proof.
5. cross_bullet_outcome_diversity: each bullet answers a distinct outcome spine — not six restatements of the same mechanism stack.
6. employer_scope_purity: no cross-employer fact leakage, wrong-company names, or facts from other employment slices.
7. current_role_unify_platform_signal: Unify reads as the candidate's current-role platform proof (governance, commercialization, scale) where evidenced.
8. protected_metric_anchor: bul_unify_006 preserves locked commercial metrics ($22M / margin / team scale) and approved metric_outcome_id anchors without splitting or diluting.
9. mechanism_inventory_cap: at most one mechanism-dense bullet; others stay outcome-led, not comma-stacked architecture inventories.

Decisive failure triggers:
- unsupported metric or cross-employer fact leakage (IBM/InsurTech/EY)
- first-person language
- wrong bullet count (expected 6)
- protected bul_unify_006 metrics missing or split incorrectly
- JD phrase copied as proof (>4 consecutive words)
- generic filler that loses Unify-specific mechanisms or protected metrics
